submission.noteMarkdown: First Agent under Owner delegation confirms existing proof boundaries, no invented epoch-one proof field. Grant exactly READ crates/vibe-install/src/slot_verify.rs, slot_verify/derivation.rs, slot_verify/m_01_c_2_cases.rs and tests/m_01_c_3_cases.rs (all four real paths verified); no install WRITE. Exercise actual supported/refused verified-original/derivation owner API against owned fixtures with precise outcomes and counters/snapshots; preserve C2/C3 proof invariants. CLI/MCP/current service must show their actual explicit observed/record-consistent strength and precise closed-shape refusal for unsupported proof inputs. Such shape refusal is not a genuine successful strict-grade query: mark that surface capability unavailable rather than pretending parity proves a stronger grade. Do not silently drop the strict owner tests or replace tamper with unsupported-input validation alone. Existing /usr/bin/strace is available and permitted for observing owned local fixture CLI/MCP/test subprocesses only, network and filesystem mutation attempts plus independent before/after trees. No attach to production/other users, no host policy/settings change, no remote provider use or product dependency on Linux strace. Label Linux observation separately from portable contract, capture exact counters/trace scope and distinguish startup/control effects from query effects honestly; do not hide attempts by reporting only successful writes. If observation fails, retain exact error and ask for bounded alternative, no security mechanism expansion. Same E2, existing WRITE ceiling only; keep independent work moving.
